name: BP Sharjah gas processing plant DCS replacement (main automation contractor)
description: Yokogawa Bulletin 00A01A55-01EN (copyright 2016): replacement of Rosemount RS3 DCS with CENTUM VP at the Sharjah gas, condensate and LPG facility about 40 km outside Sharjah city; 1,500 hardwired I/O, 2,500 serial I/O over 32 subsystems, 14 cabinets, 100 graphics, 6 FCS, 1 ENGS, 4 HIS and 1 Exaquantum server. No contract value printed.
